products.name: Blue
products.description: The verification substrate every MOBLUEHQ product runs on. A private inference mesh that returns sealed, signed results - the scheduler never sees your data, and every answer carries a receipt anyone can verify.
products.description_after: The rail underneath the portfolio. For everyone building AI into decisions that carry consequences - the layer that proves how an answer was produced, not just that it sounds right.

products.name: slumberNet
products.description: Pool your computer's spare capacity into the mesh. Install it, and your machine takes on verified AI work in the background, designed to stay out of your way when you're back at it. Built on a simple bet: if enough machines pitch in,
products.description_after: Private demo available on request. For anyone with a capable machine and spare capacity to share - the supply side that lets a verifiable mesh scale without hyperscaler lock-in.
products.stage_label: Shipped - API + app, verified over the internet
products.description_bold: much of the AI work the world does will never need a giant data center built for it.

products.name: blueAlibi
products.one_liner: Find claims the recorded evidence and tools could not support.
products.audience: Pharma regulatory ops, medical-writing/compliance teams, and law-firm filing review
products.not_this: not a global fact checker, not a legal or regulatory opinion, and provenance support does not prove a claim is true. A signed receipt proves what this software ran and recorded — nothing more.

products.name: blueFloor
products.one_liner: Measure the ingest your deployed detections can actually use.
products.audience: CISO / SecOps teams under SIEM cost pressure
products.not_this: blueFloor does not author detections or judge whether a rule is good. SUB-FLOOR means only that no supplied, enabled, successfully parsed rule is proven to consume the source and no unresolved rule can plausibly consume it. It does not mean the source has no forensic, compliance, operational, or future detection value. A signed receipt proves what blueFloor ran and recorded; it does not prove an underlying real-world claim is true.

products.name: blueIntent
products.one_liner: Check whether declared code invariants survived a change.
products.audience: AI coding platforms and regulated engineering teams (defense, fintech, cloud infrastructure) shipping AI-generated changes
products.not_this: This is not formal verification, not a claim of full semantic preservation, and not autonomous code repair.

products.name: blueParity
products.one_liner: Prove a replacement system stays equivalent within a declared contract.
products.audience: Regulated organizations mid-migration (banks, insurers, engineering firms) and the consultants running the migration
products.not_this: Equivalence is not correctness. A signed receipt proves what this software ran and recorded; it does not prove either system, or any underlying real-world claim, is correct.

products.name: bluePipeline
products.one_liner: See what actually reached the model.
products.audience: LLM engineering teams running production prompts
products.not_this: This is not a general LLM observability platform, a model-quality scorer, or an auto-repair tool.
